question: What three core disciplines are integrated into nursing informatics?

options.A: Clinical medicine, public health, and engineering
options.B: Nursing science, computer science, and information science

explanation: Nursing informatics sits at the intersection of nursing practice, computational technology, and data management systems. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h1)

question: The primary goal of integrating informatics into nursing practice is to achieve what outcome?

options.A: Replace clinical judgement with automated computer algorithms
options.B: Reduce the total number of nursing staff needed per shift
options.C: Completely eliminate paper charts across all hospital wards
options.D: Enhance data management to support safe, quality decision-making

explanation: Informatics tools are designed to assist and augment human clinical reasoning rather than replace the nurse at the bedside. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h1)

question: Which tool is a prime example of clinical nursing informatics in action?
explanation: Electronic health records directly capture and manage patient clinical data at the point of care. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h2)

question: A nurse uses a barcode scanner to check a patient's wristband prior to drug administration. What is the primary clinical benefit of this workflow?

options.A: Reduction in the cost of patient hospital bed rentals
options.C: Automatic ordering of pharmacy stock replacements
options.D: Faster completion of end-of-shift nursing handovers

explanation: Barcode verification systems match the right patient with the right medication and dose right before delivery, drastically cutting down administration mistakes. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h2)

question: What is the primary focus of nursing administration informatics?

options.A: Designing user interfaces for consumer health apps
options.B: Teaching undergraduate nursing students in a classroom
options.D: Managing resources, staffing, and operational workflows

explanation: Administrative informatics targets the macro-level operations of healthcare facilities, including staffing, budgeting, and regulatory compliance. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h3)

question: How do nurse managers use patient acuity data derived from informatics systems?

options.A: To diagnose specific medical pathologies in admitted clients
options.B: To write nursing care plans for individual ward patients
options.C: To calculate individual patient pharmaceutical billing costs
options.D: To determine appropriate nurse-to-patient staffing ratios

explanation: Patient acuity data shows how sick patients are, allowing managers to allocate nursing staff based on actual care workloads rather than just bed counts. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h3)

question: Which technology is commonly utilized in nursing education informatics?
explanation: Learning management systems are digital platforms used by educators to host course materials, quizzes, and track student engagement. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h4)

question: What is a major advantage of using virtual clinical simulations in nursing education?

options.A: It eliminates the need for theoretical classroom lectures entirely
options.B: It completely replaces the need for hands-on clinical supervision in hospitals
options.C: Students can practice managing high-risk scenarios without harming real patients
options.D: It guarantees that every student will pass their professional board examinations

explanation: Virtual simulations provide a safe environment for learners to make mistakes, learn from them, and build critical thinking without risking client safety. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h4)

question: The primary purpose of nursing research informatics is to support which activity?

options.A: Scheduling daily shift rotations for hospital staff nurses
options.B: Generating and analyzing evidence-based nursing knowledge
options.C: Monitoring real-time vital signs of intensive care patients
options.D: Processing patient insurance claims and billing statements

explanation: Research informatics focuses on tools that assist with study design, data collection, and statistical analysis to advance the nursing profession. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h5)

question: Why are standardized nursing terminologies important in nursing research informatics?

options.A: They ensure that all nursing research papers are written in the same language
options.B: They replace the need for institutional ethical approval for clinical studies
options.C: They allow data to be easily aggregated and compared across different studies and settings
options.D: They automatically publish finalized research manuscripts to academic journals

explanation: Standardized terms ensure that nursing diagnoses, interventions, and outcomes mean the exact same thing across different electronic databases and research projects. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h5)

question: What is the primary focus of consumer health informatics?

options.A: Empowering patients to manage their own health using technology
options.C: Tracking university student grades and attendance records
options.D: Managing hospital financial accounts and procurement logs

explanation: Consumer health informatics centres on tools and platforms designed for the patient and general public rather than institutional staff. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h6)

question: Which tool is a typical example of consumer health informatics?

options.A: A mobile smartphone app that tracks daily blood glucose readings
options.B: An inpatient hospital bedside medication administration cart
options.C: A national database used for hospital nurse licensure exams
options.D: An enterprise software program used for hospital budget planning

explanation: Patient-facing mobile apps used for self-monitoring fall squarely under the umbrella of consumer health informatics. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h6)

question: Which of the following is a common infrastructure challenge facing health informatics adoption in Nigeria?

options.A: A complete absence of mobile phones in the population
options.B: Too many software options causing consumer confusion
options.C: Erratic power supply and limited internet connectivity
options.D: Strict government bans on all electronic documentation

explanation: Unreliable electricity and poor internet bandwidth are well-documented infrastructural hurdles for digital health initiatives in many resource-limited settings. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h7)

question: Why is the involvement of Nigerian nurse informaticians crucial during the rollout of new hospital software?

options.A: They completely eliminate the need for IT technical support staff in hospitals
options.B: They are legally required by international law to write all hospital computer code
options.C: They understand local clinical workflows and can tailor technology to fit practical ward realities
options.D: They are the only healthcare workers permitted to purchase computer hardware

explanation: Nurse informaticians bridge the gap between technical software developers and bedside clinicians, ensuring tools are practical and safe for everyday use. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h7)
